breakingChangesNotes: The ***infobloxcloud-soc-insight-list***, ***infobloxcloud-soc-insight-event-list***, ***infobloxcloud-soc-insight-asset-list***, and ***infobloxcloud-soc-insight-indicator-list*** commands are deprecated. Use the corresponding ***infobloxcloud-iq-for-td-insight-*** commands instead. The ***infobloxcloud-soc-insight-comment-list*** command is deprecated with no available replacement. In addition, the default value of the *Ingestion Type* parameter updated from **SOC Insight** to **IQ for TD Insight**. This applies to newly created instances only; existing instances keep their saved value and are not affected on upgrade.
